direct_source_facts: NL_SOLV lines192-211 has absolute-small-residual return before selected CRIT_ITE; R01 is absolute SQRT(R02) in this shortcut even though print column says relative residual.
IMP_INIT sets N_TOL=max of selected component tolerances; EM10=1e-10, EM12=1e-12 from constant_mod.
DYNA_INI starts DY_D and DY_A at zero, retaining V in DY_V; DYNA_INA later forms predictors; INTE_DYNA derives acceleration and updates velocity.
DYNA_INIV copies displacement predictor but no CALL DYNA_INIV was found in the inspected engine tree; absence of a call is not by itself a confirmed fault.
source_startup_review.inference: The absolute stopping shortcut is evidenced and tightening tolerances engages MUMPS at startup. Its removal alone does not preserve free dynamics. Initial predictor and mixed-version restart compatibility remain hypotheses, not confirmed causes.

restart_header_review.reader_rule: Raw restart prefix followed by100big-endian int title chars, LHEADER, TABHEAD, then LVARINT big-endian ints. Verified primary C READ_I_C/Fortran RDRESA/RDCOMI; no binary changes.
restart_header_review.finding: Initial-velocity count27 is present in each fresh Starter and Engine state inspected. Loss of NINVEL alone does not explain startup. This does not prove full binary compatibility.
